title: Minimum Cost To Make Array Equalindromic
description:
A positive integer palindrome reads the same forward and backward. In one move, replace a value by any positive palindrome less than `10^9`, paying the absolute difference. Find the minimum total cost to make every value in `nums` equal to one such palindrome.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [1,2,3,4,5]
Output: 6
```

```text
Input: nums = [10,12,13,14,15]
Output: 11
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9`
